title: Treasury Rates
text:
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 800

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(jsonlite)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

ui <- page_fluid(
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5),
  navset_card_tab(
    nav_panel("Yield Curve", plotOutput("yield_plot")),
    nav_panel("Bill Rates", plotOutput("bill_plot")),
    nav_panel("Long Term", plotOutput("long_term_plot")),
    nav_panel("Real Yield", plotOutput("real_plot"))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  treasury_data <- reactive({
    jsonlite::read_json("data/treasury.json", simplifyVector = TRUE)
  })
  
  output$yield_plot <- renderPlot({
    data <- treasury_data()$yield_curve
    # Assuming data structure from treasury package (date, value, var/maturity)
    # We might need to inspect the data structure. 
    # For now, assuming standard tidy format or similar.
    # If it's wide, we might need to pivot.
    
    # Since we don't know the exact structure without running it, 
    # we'll try to plot whatever we get, or print str() if debugging.
    
    # Let's assume it has a 'date' and columns for rates.
    # If simplifyVector=TRUE, it should be a data frame.
    
    if (is.null(data)) return(NULL)
    
    # Basic visualization - needs refinement based on actual data structure
    # For now, just plotting the first numeric column vs Date if possible
    
    # If the data is a list of lists (from JSON), simplifyVector might handle it.
    
    # Placeholder plot
    plot(1, type="n", main="Yield Curve Data Loaded")
    text(1, 1, paste("Rows:", nrow(data)))
  })
  
  output$bill_plot <- renderPlot({
    plot(1, type="n", main="Bill Rates")
  })
  
  output$long_term_plot <- renderPlot({
    plot(1, type="n", main="Long Term Rates")
  })
  
  output$real_plot <- renderPlot({
    plot(1, type="n", main="Real Yield Rates")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

title: treasury 0.4.0
text:
treasury 0.4.0

Fixed bug in checking for {readxl} installation.
Improved documentation.
Renamed functions for consistency:

tr_bill_rates() to tr_bill_rate()
tr_par_yields() to tr_par_yield()




treasury 0.3.0

Migration to data.table package. Internal data manipulation is now done using data.table and all functions return data.table objects.



treasury 0.2.0

Better documentation.
Support for Treasury High Quality Market (HQM) Corporate Bond Yield Curve data.
Support for Treasury Nominal Coupon-Issue (TNC) Yield Curve data.
Support for Treasury Real Coupon-Issue (TRC) Yield Curve data.
Support for Treasury Breakeven Inflation Curve (TBI curve) data.



treasury 0.1.0

Initial CRAN submission.

title: Daily Dashboard
text:
This is the daily dashboard.
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 400

library(shiny)
library(bslib)

ui <- page_fluid(
  h2("Hello Shinylive"),
  sliderInput("obs", "Number of observations:",
              min = 0, max = 1000, value = 500
  ),
  plotOutput("distPlot")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    hist(rnorm(input$obs))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

title: XKCD
text:
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 800

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(jsonlite)

ui <- page_fluid(
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5),
  uiOutput("comic_ui")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  comic_data <- reactive({
    # Read the pre-fetched data
    # In Shinylive, files in 'resources' are available at the root or relative path
    jsonlite::read_json("data/xkcd.json")
  })
  
  output$comic_ui <- renderUI({
    data <- comic_data()
    
    card(
      card_header(data$title),
      div(
        style = "text-align: center;",
        a(
          href = data$explain_url,
          target = "_blank",
          title = data$explain_url, # Hover for URL
          img(
            src = data$img,
            title = data$alt, # Hover for alt text (standard behavior)
            style = "max-width: 100%; height: auto; cursor: pointer;"
          )
        )
      ),
      card_footer(data$alt)
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
